phone.changelog: v3.9.23: catalog fallback — direct TMDB API if proxy down.

tv.changelog: v3.17.27: Fixed blank catalog + poster loading + try-everything failover. TMDB API now falls back to direct api.themoviedb.org if VPS proxy is down. Posters load directly from image.tmdb.org (no proxy). Failover now tries: all servers → native handoff → engine toggle, before giving up. Server health cache persists across restarts.
